# RankFrame SEO

> RankFrame SEO is a full-service SEO and web studio for businesses in every industry. 30+ websites audited and optimized. We do everything SEO — technical & on-page SEO, keyword & content, local SEO with Google Business Profile, Google Maps and Apple Maps, AI search (GEO) visibility in ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews, off-page authority and backlinks, e-commerce SEO, and modern website design & build. Customers select the services they need and we reply in 2–6 hours with a tailored, one-on-one plan.

## Services

Customers can mix and match any of the following:

### Technical & On-Page SEO
SEO architecture and site-structure audit, title tags and meta descriptions, heading and content structure, JSON-LD schema markup, XML sitemap creation and submission, robots.txt and crawl-budget optimization, canonical tags and duplicate-content fixes, internal linking, image and media optimization, Core Web Vitals and page-speed, broken link / 404 / redirect cleanup, HTTPS and indexing checks.

### Keyword & Content
Keyword research and search-intent mapping, competitor keyword gap analysis, content strategy and topic clusters, on-page content writing and optimization, blog and article SEO writing, landing-page copy, content refreshes, FAQ and featured-snippet optimization.

### Local SEO & Maps
Google Business Profile setup and optimization, Google Maps listing and ranking, Apple Maps / Apple Business Connect setup and fixes, Bing Places for Business, NAP consistency, 50+ business directory citations, local landing pages by city or service area, review generation and response, LocalBusiness schema.

### AI Search & GEO
Getting your brand cited in ChatGPT answers, Google AI Overviews optimization, Perplexity and Gemini visibility, llms.txt and AI-crawler discovery files, entity and knowledge-graph optimization, AI-friendly structured content.

### Off-Page & Authority
Backlink acquisition (quality links), guest-post outreach on high-authority sites, competitor backlink gap analysis, toxic backlink audit and disavow, brand mention monitoring and link reclamation, digital PR, domain authority growth tracking.

### E-commerce SEO
Product and collection page optimization, Product schema (price, rating, availability), faceted navigation and crawl control, Shopify / WooCommerce technical SEO, marketplace / Amazon listing optimization.

### Website Design & Build
New website design and build, landing-page design and development, website redesign / rebuild, speed and performance optimization, mobile and responsive optimization, conversion-rate optimization (CRO), ongoing maintenance and support.

### Analytics & Reporting
Google Analytics 4 setup, Google Search Console setup and monitoring, keyword ranking tracking, monthly SEO performance reports, conversion and goal tracking, competitor monitoring.

## Who It's For

- Local service businesses that want to own the Google and Apple map pack
- E-commerce stores that need product and category pages to rank
- SaaS and startups that want visibility in Google and AI search
- Professional services, healthcare, hospitality, and any business that wants to be found online
- High-risk and restricted industries where paid ads are limited or banned (CBD, supplements, crypto, gaming, firearms, adult-adjacent) — organic SEO is often their single most reliable growth channel
- Businesses that want to be cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews

## Case Study

**PACK EXPO International** (packexpointernational.com, trade show platform, 40,000+ annual attendees) — RankFrame SEO audit estimated **$200,000–$575,000 per month** of organic traffic value being left on the table due to fixable technical SEO architecture issues. Five core fixes were identified: title tags, schema markup, internal linking, Core Web Vitals, and canonical tags. Organic traffic increased 180% over nine months.

Full case study: https://rankframeseo.com/case-study-pack-expo.pdf

## FAQ

**Q: What services do you offer?**
A: The full range of SEO and web work — technical & on-page SEO, keyword and content, local SEO with Google Business Profile, Google Maps and Apple Maps, AI search (GEO) visibility so you get cited by ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews, off-page authority and backlinks, e-commerce SEO, website design and build, plus analytics and monthly reporting. You choose exactly what you need.

**Q: How does it work?**
A: On the Get Started page you select the services you're interested in. Your selection is emailed to us instantly and we reply in 2–6 hours with a tailored, one-on-one plan. There's no obligation.

**Q: Which industries do you work with?**
A: Every industry — local service businesses, e-commerce, SaaS and tech, professional services, healthcare, hospitality, and more. This includes high-risk and restricted verticals where paid ads are limited or banned (CBD, supplements, crypto, gaming, firearms, adult-adjacent), where organic SEO is often the most reliable growth channel.

**Q: Can you get my business cited by ChatGPT and AI search?**
A: Yes. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) makes your site citation-ready for ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews through structured data, entity optimization, llms.txt discovery files, and AI-friendly content.

**Q: Do you add and fix Google Maps and Apple Maps listings?**
A: Yes. We set up and optimize Google Business Profile and Google Maps rankings, and set up or fix Apple Maps / Apple Business Connect and Bing Places, with consistent NAP data and directory citations.

**Q: Do you also build websites?**
A: Yes. We design and build fast, modern websites and landing pages engineered to rank from day one, and can redesign or optimize an existing site for speed, mobile, and conversions.

**Q: How long until I see ranking improvements?**
A: On-page fixes can show crawl improvements within 2–4 weeks. Ranking changes typically become visible at 60–90 days and compound over 6 months.

## Author / Team

Content published on RankFrame SEO is authored by **Blue Galaxy**, a technical SEO practitioner with experience auditing trade-show platforms, service businesses, and e-commerce sites. Blog and playbooks focus on durable, Google-guideline-compliant technical SEO (no black-hat tactics).

Medium: https://medium.com/@bluegalaxydev

## Why This Exists (Problem Framing)

Most business websites lose organic rankings not because of product or pricing, but because Google's crawler and AI engines cannot parse their site architecture, local presence, and authority signals. Missing title tags, absent schema markup, weak internal linking, incomplete Google/Apple Maps listings, and slow Core Web Vitals make content effectively invisible. RankFrame SEO fixes the whole foundation — technical, local, AI-search, and authority — so businesses in any industry can compete.

## Key Statistics RankFrame Cites

- 68% of online experiences begin with a search engine
- 53% of all website traffic comes from organic search
- Only 0.63% of users click results from page two of Google
- SEO leads convert at 14.6% vs 1.7% for outbound
